_why: BOX B — the operations box. What it runs, declared as DATA and read back by tooling/ops/check-box-declared.mjs (READ-ONLY over SSH: exit 1 on drift, 2 when it could not look). Until this file, what the box runs was spread across Private runbooks, tooling/ops/register.json, tooling/monitor-register.json, tooling/ops/alarm-chains.json and the box itself (row O-BOXES-NOT-DECLARED-AS-DATA).

Every value here is either a name, a schedule, a version, or a CITATION of the register that owns the fact (monitors by id, crons by register row, backup sets by tooling/boxes/backups.json id, cost by Private vendor id). No address is ever written here: the box is reached through the environment names under `ssh`, which the operator fills from the vault.

Sources read for the first draft (2026-10-01): tooling/monitor-register.json `_notInThisRegister` (the hostnames and versions), tooling/ops/register.json (the crons, their schedules and the timezone), tooling/ops/alarm-chains.json `expectedMonitors` (the heartbeat ids). A field the public tree does not state is null, and the read-back reports it as UNREAD (LOST) until the first read fills it — never a guess presented as a measurement.

cost.why: Cited by vendor id, never copied: CI cannot read Private, so box-move grades the cost delta LOST there.

spec.verify: check-box-declared.mjs reads nproc, free -b and df -B1 / and compares (RAM and disk within 15% below the plan's figure)

volumes.name: /opt/glitchtip
volumes.holds: the GlitchTip compose project and its nightly dumps (backups/)

volumes.name: /opt/backup
volumes.holds: the restic run, its set list (restic-sets.txt) and the third-copy scripts

volumes.name: /opt/diun
volumes.holds: Diun's configuration and its run log

volumes.name: /srv/restic
volumes.holds: the LOCAL restic repository (one of three)

tunnel.why: Every hostname is a CNAME to one Cloudflare tunnel, no public port opened (tooling/monitor-register.json `_notInThisRegister`): the records do not change in a move; the connector runs on the target with this secret.

allowLists.where: the API Setu partner console: the IP whitelist on the platform's API key
allowLists.verify: read the key's whitelist in the API Setu console and compare it to the declared address

allowLists.where: Box C's firewall and sshd: the second-copy sync and the Beszel agent are reached from this box's address
allowLists.verify: on Box C, read the firewall rules (ufw status / nft list ruleset) for the declared address

_toConfirm: Read back on the first run and fill, never guess: the compose project names of vaultwarden, ntfy, beszel-hub and dozzle; the image and version of GlitchTip's database and cache; the minutes of the two hourly liveness crons; every OS unit beyond the five named; every named docker volume. `node tooling/ops/check-box-declared.mjs boxb --print-observed` prints what was read, names only.
